_comment: Swift test targets that no automatic runner covers (scripts/ci/swift_test_coverage.py, hq#11644). Each entry is either run_by: a workflow that runs the whole package on its pull requests (checked), or not_run: why no pull request check runs it. Prefer a runner: scripts/ci/swift-linux-packages.txt, PACKAGES in scripts/ci/package-test-lane.sh, or a fast-tier.json entry for CmuxNext. A not_run reason that names a failure is a red test: fix it and move the package to a runner. The failures below are from package-test-lane.sh suite on an owned Mac at ccc9958672bf (2026-11-15).

targets.not_run: a lab package whose suites include frame-time budgets (HomeBackgroundLoadPerfTests, DragWhileStreamingTests) and layout checks; 1 of its 2 suites fails on an owned Mac (HomeRetrySendTests, HomeMenuHighlightFollowTests, HomeOpensAtNewestTests among others) and drag tests take 40 s each
same package as MessagesLabHomeTests: the package lane runs a package whole, and MessagesLabHomeTests fails on an owned Mac
red on feat-cmux-next: NoSystemSpinnerTests.noSystemSpinners finds UIActivityIndicatorView in cmux-next-ios/CmuxMobileKit (ChiefSlashSuggestionsView.swift:147 and others), and the scan takes 70 s

macOS-only (AppKit), and red on an owned Mac: MacComposerAttachmentTests.finderCopyOfAnImageFilePastesThePhoto reads no image from the pasteboard; Core and Geometry run on Linux (scripts/ci/swift-linux-packages.txt)
